summary: Pampa Energía S.A. (Pampa Energy Inc.) furnished a Form 6-K containing its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the nine- and three-month periods ended September 30, 2026, prepared under IFRS and reviewed by Price Waterhouse & Co. S.R.L. The filing is a routine foreign-issuer periodic report (US equivalent of a quarterly report on Form 10-Q), signed by CEO Gustavo Mariani and dated November 4, 2026. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, or strategic event is disclosed; no special-situation angle or risk-arb consideration applies.
